collection.title: Nissan Leaf 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Nissan Leaf 2018 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. we also have rear blade for this Leaf, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
